description: Change of use of the ground floor from A1 (retail) to restaurant (A3) and hot food takeaway (A5), the erection of a part single storey and part three storey extension, the conversion of the upper floors of the building to two flats and the conversion of a two-storey building at the rear of the site to a one-bedroom house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - - -  roller SHUTTER  ####### No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered site location plan, 1024-ex-01, 02 and Design and Access Statement received 19/01/2011 and 04 A received 19/04/2011 and 1024-pl-03 B received 08/06/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [0900-2200 Monday to Saturday and 0900-2300 Sundays and Bank Holidays].
Condition : 5 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of [0700-1700].

Condition : 6 - Before the use hereby permitted is brought into operation, details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the premises and the residential flats above shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented before the use commences and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the ground floor shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor, a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level and glass entrance doors and glazed screens must be clearly defined with manifestation on the glass at two levels: 850mm to 1000mm and 1400mm to 1600mm. The manifestation should be a sing or logo at least 150mm high.

Condition : 8 - A bacterial or enzyme dosing unit shall be fitted on all waste discharge points from kitchen sinks and floor drains prior to discharging to the public sewerage system and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order.

Condition : 9 - Any back door to the restaurant/takeaway shall be fitted with a self closer which shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order and the door shall be kept [permanently closed except when being used to enter or leave the premises.

Condition : 10 - Before the use hereby approved begins, a fat trap shall be installed and maintained/renewed for the duration of the use and an agreement shall be in place with a contractor for the off-site disposal of fats, oils and grease, particularly to recycle for the production of bio-diesel. These arrangements shall be permanently operated and retained.

Condition : 11 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided, before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.

Condition : 12 - The use shall not commence until the secure storage area within the site between the proposed rear extension and the 2m tall boundary wall to the private amenity space for the proposed detached house to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the use is commenced and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal weekly collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
